block_readings.visual_reading: Six centres lie in the continuous dark, wave-textured marine surface, including dark surface streaks; no opaque feature covers their marked locations.
All132 marked centres are on continuous dark water; a turquoise reef enters the lower-right frame beyond the centres. Dark streaks show continuing marine texture rather than a mapped land body.

Most51 centres lie on dark water. Two centres3976/3978 fall on a small pale turquoise shoal/reef patch whose exact exposure is unresolved. The large upper-right reef and small bright structure are outside the marked centres.

All8 centres track a pale reef-edge/shoal band. NIR is comparatively dark and water-associated but10m imagery does not resolve whether each exact point is submerged reef, surf or mixed exposed material. Small cloud patches elsewhere do not drive these questions.

The full RGB/NIR frames visibly show an engineered island, runway, road/building blocks and enclosed harbour beside reef-coloured water. Thirteen assigned centres reach the western/southwestern edge/body: nine have terrestrial built-body placement, four retain edge-side questions. The other144 centres are in visible surrounding water. SCL6 at4250/4260 cannot override their bright built-body placement; cloud8/9 at other built-body points remains a model flag, not a claim an opaque cloud obscures these recognizable structures.
All16 marked centres are in dark wave-textured water at frame edge; small clouds/shadows elsewhere do not cover their positions.
All15 marked centres are in continuous water; small cloud patches in upper/left context and a turquoise patch at bottom are away from the centres.
All10 centres are in continuous wave-textured water; no terrestrial or opaque-cloud object intersects their registered positions.
All27 centres lie in visible continuous marine texture across a radiometric diagonal band; that band is not itself a land boundary. No exact shore claim is made.
All6 marked centres are water locations amid sea-surface streaks.

All62 centres have water appearance. At4421 the thin-cirrus10 flag is retained; the marked surface and its local raw low-NIR neighbourhood remain marine-looking, so the date-specific water appearance is qualified rather than silently relabelled clear sky.
All142 marked locations remain outside the shallow reef entering the lower-right context and have continuous water appearance. This partial-height native edge window is read as returned.

Most229 centres are dark water around the reef. Nine4784..4792 occupy the bright shallow reef/crest context and remain exact exposure questions. Four subsequent marked points4793..4796 are waterward in the dark surface; one unusually low-DN patch remains valid source data, not invented nodata. Thin-cirrus10 at4437/4449/4548 is retained while visible marine texture supports a bounded water appearance.
